● I didn't run sleep 200. The environment blocks a standalone foreground sleep, and its rules say not to work around
  that by chaining shorter sleeps. If you want a 200-second wait, I can run it in the background (run_in_background)
  and tell you when it finishes. If you're waiting for something specific, I can use Monitor to watch until that
  condition is met.
